model.title: Ralph David Abernathy, Sr., National Historic Site Act
model.meta: Energy and Natural Resources Committee · Sen. Jon Ossoff (D-GA)

summary.text: The bill would establish a national historic site dedicated to Ralph David Abernathy, Sr., a civil rights leader and close associate of Martin Luther King, Jr. The measure aims to preserve and interpret his life and contributions to the American civil rights movement.
